mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as turnover_amount, count(1) as order_count, coalesce(sum((select coalesce(sum(i.quantity), 0) from biz_order_item i where i.order_id = o.id)), 0) as cup_count from biz_order o where
select o.order_status, count(1) as status_count from biz_order o where group by o.order_status

select i.product_id, i.product_name, coalesce(sum(i.quantity), 0) as quantity, coalesce(sum(i.subtotal), 0) as sales_amount from biz_order o inner join biz_order_item i on i.order_id = o.id where group by i.product_id, i.product_name order by quantity desc, sales_amount desc, i.product_id asc limit #{limit}
